Classify Fingertips indicators from their names

Source: R/fingertips.R
classify_fingertips_indicators.Rd

UKHSA indicator names encode the period type and the measure (for example "12-month rolling" or "financial year"), and the metadata Frequency field is mostly missing, so the names are parsed instead. This is the classification that download_fingertips_amr attaches to every row it returns.

Usage

classify_fingertips_indicators(indicator_name)

Arguments

indicator_name

character vector of Fingertips indicator names.

Value

A data.frame with one row per name and columns:

is_rolling

logical; the name mentions a rolling window.

period_type

one of "12-month rolling, monthly steps", "rolling 4-quarter average, quarterly steps", "financial year", "calendar year", "quarter", "month", "year (see definition)", "unspecified".

theme

one of "prescribing", "resistance", "testing", "cases", "stewardship", "ipc", "other".

organism

e.g. "E. coli", or NA.

specimen

"blood", "urine" or NA.

onset

"hospital-onset", "community-onset" or NA.

Details

Note that "rolling quarterly average" indicators report the average quarterly count over the last four quarters (rounded to an integer), not a discrete quarterly count.

Examples

classify_fingertips_indicators(c(
  "E. coli bacteraemia: 12-month rolling count",
  "Escherichia coli urine resistance to trimethoprim: quarterly"
))
#>   is_rolling                     period_type      theme organism specimen onset
#> 1       TRUE 12-month rolling, monthly steps      cases  E. coli    blood  <NA>
#> 2      FALSE                         quarter resistance     <NA>    urine  <NA>
